title: .ticfac/ run-state store: checkpoint, attempt, decision, evidence with compare-and-swap against origin
description: internal/runstate: writer/reader for .ticfac/runs/<run-id>/{checkpoint.json, attempts/<n>.json, decisions/<n>.json, evidence/<key>.json} per contracts/ticfac-run-state.json and the evidence record in job-protocol.json (nested provenance, closed). Persistence policy: durable means pushed on origin; every write is commit + push in one operation on the EpicRun integration branch; create-if-absent for attempts and SHA-guarded update for checkpoints implemented exactly as the 7 executable CAS sequences (git push --force-with-lease on the local host); a conflict is a typed outcome, not an error to retry blindly. Checkpoint only on state change. Terminal state places the tag ticfac/run-<run-id>. .gitignore fragment installed (index and logs ignored). Tests: the contract sequences run against the REAL git (temp bare origin), plus the schemas.
acceptance_criteria: All 7 CAS sequences pass against a real bare origin; a checkpoint written by a stale writer is refused; attempts are create-once; the tag exists at terminal state; the fragment is honoured by git check-ignore; go test -short ./internal/runstate/... green.
